summary: A woman with a prosthetic arm confronts a man on a bridge, who then admits he is freaked out.

dialogue.speaker: UNKNOWN
dialogue.text: All right, fine. I'm freaked out.

visuals.description: A man and a woman stand facing each other on a bridge. The woman has a detailed prosthetic arm and gestures with it towards the man. The man looks at her, then down, then back up as he speaks.
notable_elements: Woman's black and blue athletic jacket
Woman's black leggings with pink stripe
